xBRIEFInfo.description: Story xBRIEF for GitHub issue #2805 — detect dual-layout (deft/ + .deft/core/) and guide or remove the leftover legacy tree.

plan.title: bug: frozen bridge leaves tracked legacy deft tree and Doctor misses dual layout

narratives.Description: The frozen bridge can leave a tracked legacy `deft/` framework tree beside a new `.deft/core/` deposit, but Doctor short-circuits to skip as soon as `.deft/core/` exists. Operators then see a false clean `legacy-layout` check while conflicting framework trees remain on disk and in git. This story teaches Doctor (and the npm upgrade path) to detect dual-layout and either remove a clean tracked legacy tree or fail closed with explicit cleanup guidance.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1. Update `packages/core/src/init-deposit/legacy-detect.ts` so a present `.deft/core/` no longer hides a remaining framework `deft/` tree; introduce a dual-layout kind with evidence for both roots. 2. Wire Doctor `legacy-layout` / signpost output in `packages/core/src/doctor/checks.ts` (and related signpost tests) to fail or warn until the legacy tree is removed, and add an npm-side cleanup or staging helper when the legacy tree has no local modifications. 3. Add regression tests in `packages/core/src/init-deposit/legacy-detect.test.ts` and `packages/core/src/doctor/signpost-checks.test.ts` that fixture dual-layout and assert Doctor no longer skips.
narratives.UserStory: As a Directive consumer finishing a bridge upgrade, I want Doctor to detect a leftover `deft/` tree beside `.deft/core/`, so that I do not keep shipping dual framework layouts.
narratives.Overview:
## Summary

The frozen v0.58.0 Go bridge successfully deposits the canonical `.deft/core/` layout but leaves a tracked legacy `deft/` framework tree in place. Directive 0.84.0 Doctor then reports `legacy-layout: skip -- No legacy Deft layout detected`, despite the legacy tree still existing and remaining tracked.

## Expected

The bridge should either remove the clean tracked legacy framework tree, stage its deletion, or fail with explicit cleanup guidance. Doctor should detect a dual-layout state until the old tree is removed.
narratives.Labels: bug, adoption-blocker, doctor, Upgrade Blocker, vendored-deposit, area:installer

items.title: Given deft/ and .deft/core/ both present, when Doctor checks legacy-layout, then it fails dual-layout instead of skipping.

narrative.Acceptance: Given a project with both a framework-marked `deft/` tree and a canonical `.deft/core/` deposit, when Doctor runs the `legacy-layout` check, then it fails with a dual-layout finding and does not report skip.

items.title: Given a clean tracked legacy deft/ tree, when the npm upgrade cleanup path runs, then it removes or stages deletion of that tree.

narrative.Acceptance: Given a dual-layout consumer whose legacy `deft/` tree has no local modifications or untracked files, when the npm upgrade cleanup path runs, then it deletes or stages deletion of `deft/` and leaves `.deft/core/` as the sole framework root.

items.title: Given a dirty legacy deft/ tree, when cleanup runs, then it refuses destructive removal and returns explicit remediation.

narrative.Acceptance: Given a dual-layout consumer whose legacy `deft/` tree has local modifications, when the npm upgrade cleanup path runs, then it refuses destructive removal and returns explicit remediation telling the operator how to reconcile the tree.

expected_outputs: Doctor legacy-layout no longer skips when deft/ remains
